description:
Desktop AI agent with plugins, an embedded browser, workspace files, and local model support.

Lexora is a personal AI agent that evolves through hands-on work on your desktop. Beyond coding, it helps you organize research, refine creative projects, and plan everyday activities. Tell it what you want to accomplish, and it keeps working toward that goal, making words the starting point for work, creativity, and everyday life.
This release focuses on Lexora Office and document workflows. Alongside the Office plugin, we added file-opening preferences, content references, bundled skills, clipboard access, and private document storage—connecting document editing, conversations, and AI-generated deliverables so companions can work with documents rather than only discuss them.
This version also introduces a Windows ZIP distribution, customizable companion stickers and notification sounds, plus improvements to reading position, companion collaboration, and the built-in browser.
